================================================================================
Literal keyword does not split a longer word
:cst
================================================================================
literal:matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:16   program
0:0  - 0:16     literal
0:0  - 0:8        "literal:"
0:8  - 0:16       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Fixed regex keyword does not split a longer word
:cst
================================================================================
regex:matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:14   program
0:0  - 0:14     fixed_regex
0:0  - 0:6        "regex:"
0:6  - 0:14       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Singleton character class does not split a longer word
:cst
================================================================================
class:matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:14   program
0:0  - 0:14     singleton_class
0:0  - 0:6        "class:"
0:6  - 0:14       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Duplicate alternatives do not split a longer word
:cst
================================================================================
grouped:matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:16   program
0:0  - 0:16     grouped
0:0  - 0:8        "grouped:"
0:8  - 0:16       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Exact repetition does not split a longer word
:cst
================================================================================
repeat:matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:15   program
0:0  - 0:15     exact_repeat
0:0  - 0:7        "repeat:"
0:7  - 0:15       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Literal keyword followed by a separate word
================================================================================
literal:match box
---
(program (literal (literal_statement (word))))

================================================================================
Fixed regex keyword followed by a separate word
================================================================================
regex:match box
---
(program (fixed_regex (regex_statement (word))))

================================================================================
Singleton character class followed by a separate word
================================================================================
class:match box
---
(program (singleton_class (class_statement (word))))

================================================================================
Duplicate alternatives followed by a separate word
================================================================================
grouped:match box
---
(program (grouped (grouped_statement (word))))

================================================================================
Exact repetition followed by a separate word
================================================================================
repeat:match box
---
(program (exact_repeat (repeat_statement (word))))

================================================================================
Whitespace before a longer word does not make it an immediate keyword
:cst
================================================================================
regex: matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:15   program
0:0  - 0:15     fixed_regex
0:0  - 0:6        "regex:"
0:7  - 0:15       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Whitespace before a longer word preserves literal boundaries
:cst
================================================================================
literal: matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:17   program
0:0  - 0:17     literal
0:0  - 0:8        "literal:"
0:9  - 0:17       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Whitespace before a longer word preserves singleton-class boundaries
:cst
================================================================================
class: matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:15   program
0:0  - 0:15     singleton_class
0:0  - 0:6        "class:"
0:7  - 0:15       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Whitespace before a longer word preserves duplicate-alternative boundaries
:cst
================================================================================
grouped: matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:17   program
0:0  - 0:17     grouped
0:0  - 0:8        "grouped:"
0:9  - 0:17       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Whitespace before a longer word preserves exact-repetition boundaries
:cst
================================================================================
repeat: matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:16   program
0:0  - 0:16     exact_repeat
0:0  - 0:7        "repeat:"
0:8  - 0:16       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Multi-spelling regex keeps its prefix-token behavior
:cst
================================================================================
general:matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:16   program
0:0  - 0:16     general_regex
0:0  - 0:8        "general:"
0:8  - 0:16       general_statement
0:8  - 0:13         prefix_keyword `match`
0:13 - 0:16         word `box`

================================================================================
Optional suffix regex keeps its prefix-token behavior
:cst
================================================================================
optional:matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:17   program
0:0  - 0:17     optional_regex
0:0  - 0:9        "optional:"
0:9  - 0:17       optional_statement
0:9  - 0:14         optional_keyword `match`
0:14 - 0:17         word `box`

================================================================================
Distinct alternatives keep their prefix-token behavior
:cst
================================================================================
alternative:matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:20   program
0:0  - 0:20     alternative_regex
0:0  - 0:12       "alternative:"
0:12 - 0:20       alternative_statement
0:12 - 0:17         alternative_keyword `match`
0:17 - 0:20         word `box`

================================================================================
Multi-character-class fixed repetition keeps its prefix-token behavior
:cst
================================================================================
length:matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:15   program
0:0  - 0:15     fixed_length_regex
0:0  - 0:7        "length:"
0:7  - 0:15       length_statement
0:7  - 0:12         length_keyword `match`
0:12 - 0:15         word `box`

================================================================================
Literal keyword works when the word token is not valid
================================================================================
literal-only:match box
---
(program (required_literal (literal_statement (word))))

================================================================================
Fixed regex keyword works when the word token is not valid
================================================================================
regex-only:match box
---
(program (required_regex (regex_statement (word))))

================================================================================
Literal keyword cannot split a longer word even when the word token is not valid
:error
================================================================================
literal-only:matchbox
---
(ERROR (word))

================================================================================
Fixed regex keyword cannot split a longer word even when the word token is not valid
:error
================================================================================
regex-only:matchbox
---
(ERROR (word))

================================================================================
Whitespace prevents an immediate literal keyword
:error
================================================================================
literal-only: match box
---
(ERROR (word) (word))

================================================================================
Whitespace prevents an immediate fixed regex keyword
:error
================================================================================
regex-only: match box
---
(ERROR (word) (word))
